title: Cash on Delivery Instrument
description: Selects settlement on delivery: the buyer pays the carrier when the order arrives. The platform submits no payment credential, so this instrument carries none; selecting it is the whole payment authorisation the business needs to place the order. Because no credential is transmitted, no participant enters PCI DSS scope for this instrument.

constraint_target.title: Cash on Delivery Constraint Target
constraint_target.description: Members a business may name in `available_instruments[].constraints`. Never carried in a payload — the business derives each value from its own configuration.

provider_code.description: The business's identifier for the settlement provider behind this instrument, as configured on the business (e.g. 'cash_on_delivery'). Lets a business narrow availability to specific providers.

display.description: Presentation data for this instrument, resolved by the business in the authoritative response.

label.description: Buyer-facing name of the payment method in the checkout's locale.

instructions.description: Buyer-facing guidance the business wants shown before completion.

fee.description: Surcharge this instrument adds to the order, already reflected in the checkout totals. Absent when the instrument adds no fee.
